sn1.33:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā Satullapakāyikā devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhaṃsu || || 3.
sn1.33:1.3: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udānesi || ||
sn1.33:3.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udānesi || ||
sn1.33:4.2: api ca appasmim pi sādhu dānaṃ ||
sn1.33:6.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udanesi || ||
sn1.33:7.3: Api ca saddhāya pi sādhu dānam ||
sn1.33:7.7: ten-eva so hoti sukhī paratthā ti || || 6.
sn1.33:8.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udānesi || ||
sn1.33:9.4: api ca dhammaladdhassa pi sādhu dānaṃ || ||
sn1.33:11.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udānesi || ||
sn1.33:14.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udānesi || ||
sn1.33:15.6: Api ca pāṇesu ca sādhu saṃyamo || ||
sn1.33:16.3: bhīruṃ pasaṃsanti na hi tattha sūraṃ ||
sn1.33:16.4: bhayā hi santo na karonti pāpan ti || || 9.
sn1.33:17.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn1.33:17.2: Kassā nu kho Bhagavā subhāsitan ti || ||
sn1.33:18.1: Sabbāsaṃ vo subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena || api mamam pi suṇātha || ||
sn1.33:19.2: dānā ca kho dhammapadaṃ va seyyo || ||
